_README: Fill these in. Required: name, url, tagline, short_description, long_description, categories, pricing, email. logo_path (a real local PNG) is required by many directories that block submission without a logo upload.
name: Your Tool Name
tagline: One sentence pitch, ~80 characters, no period.
short_description: 1–2 sentences, ~160 characters. What it does, for whom.
long_description: 2–4 paragraphs. Problem solved, who it's for, what's unique, key features. Plain text, no markdown.
pricing_options: One of: Free, Freemium, Free Trial, Paid, Contact
